entities.name: Strixhaven: Omens of Chaos
entities.description: A young adult novel by Seanan McGuire, published April 7, 2026, set a school year before Secrets of Strixhaven.

entities.name: Eula Blue
entities.description: A young woman from New Capenna who was meant to be a shield mage and receives an invitation to Strixhaven.

entities.name: Alandra
entities.description: A merfolk girl with a flair for art and mischief, a fellow student of Eula.

entities.name: Segante Guarneri
entities.description: A mysterious boy with secrets whom Eula longs to know.

entities.name: Kequia Akosa
entities.description: One of the five major characters of the novel.

entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: A magical school on Arcavios that admits its first multiplanar class.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane on which Strixhaven University stands.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: Eula's home plane, devastated by the war.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: The routes by which students travel to Arcavios.

entities.name: Seanan McGuire
entities.description: The author of the novel, who campaigned for pre-orders.

entities.name: Kasmina
entities.description: Quoted in the flavor text of the promo Command Tower.

events.summary: Eula Blue receives an invitation to study at Strixhaven and accepts.
events.quote: Given a chance to return to her study of magic, Eula leaps to take it.

events.summary: Eula bonds with fellow students Alandra and Segante.
events.quote: a merfolk girl with a flair for art and mischief

events.summary: The multiplanar students become targets for enemies within and without.
events.quote: Eula and the other multiplanar students quickly become a target for enemies within and without.

events.summary: The book's release is moved after a pre-order campaign by Seanan McGuire.
events.quote: The book was initially slated for release on February 17, 2026.
